column1: # Measured 2026-10-04 against /opt/homebrew/bin/zsh (zsh 5.9.2) with its own zmv:
# in a fresh directory holding the files of column 1 (each containing its
# own name), `zsh -fc 'autoload -Uz zmv; COMMAND; print -r -- st=$?'` with
# both streams together; newlines are written ~. Column 4 lists what the
# directory held afterwards: path:contents, path/ for a directory, and
# path -> target for a symbolic link.
